Yb2O3(l).derivation: Integrate the printed C-phase Cp through 2687 K, add the C-to-H transition enthalpy 27 kJ/mol, integrate H-phase Cp to 2707 K, then add the H-to-liquid fusion enthalpy 84 kJ/mol. The total C-to-liquid increment is 27 + 84 = 111 kJ/mol; at 2707 K the liquid Gibbs function joins the crystal Gibbs function. The liquid Cp is the printed 146 J/(mol K).
Yb2O3(l).anchor_phase: C-type crystal at 298.15 K; the liquid Gibbs function is constructed through the C-to-H transition and fusion.

Yb2SiO5(l).solid_Cp_basis: Dulong-Petit high-temperature estimate, 3 n R, for 8 atoms per formula unit
Yb2SiO5(l).fusion_entropy_estimate_basis: Measured Yb2Si2O7 fusion entropy scaled by the formula atom ratio 8/11
Yb2SiO5(l).liquid_Cp_estimate_basis: Yb2O3(l) Cp scaled by formula atom count: 146 * 8/5
Yb2SiO5(l).derivation: The primary drop-solution value from oxides is the target for this liquid association: ΔHrxn(298) = −49.45 kJ/mol. Rebase the crystalline product enthalpy on the matching crystalline oxide anchors: ΔfH298(Yb2SiO5) = −1814.5 + (−905.489) + (−49.45) = −2769.439 kJ/mol. Liang et al.'s independent elemental formation value is −2774.75 kJ/mol, 5.31 kJ/mol from this rebased value and within the printed ±8.35 kJ/mol oxide-cycle uncertainty. Solid Cp uses 3 n R; fusion entropy is 151000/2123.15 * 8/11 = 51.7241748 J/(mol K), giving ΔHfus = 114.990599 kJ/mol at 2223.15 K. Liquid Cp is 146 * 8/5 = 233.6 J/(mol K). Units: the Hess terms are kJ/mol, Cp is J/(mol K), and ΔHfus = T ΔS/1000 is kJ/mol.
Yb2SiO5(l).anchor_phase: Crystalline silicate at 298.15 K; the liquid Gibbs function is constructed through fusion and liquid Cp.

Yb2Si2O7(l).solid_Cp_basis: Dulong-Petit high-temperature estimate, 3 n R, for 11 atoms per formula unit
Yb2Si2O7(l).liquid_Cp_estimate_basis: Yb2O3(l) Cp scaled by formula atom count: 146 * 11/5
Yb2Si2O7(l).derivation: At 42 mol% SiO2, Costa et al. report ΔHs(Yb2O3)=+2.41, ΔHs(SiO2)=−12.53, and ΔHs(Yb2Si2O7)=+136.22 kJ/mol in Table 3. The Hess target is ΔHrxn(oxides) = 2.41 + 2(−12.53) − 136.22 = −158.87 kJ/mol; independent two-sigma spreads combine as sqrt(13.44^2 + 4(6.40^2) + 7.13^2) = 19.88 kJ/mol. Rebase the crystalline product enthalpy on the matching crystalline oxide anchors: ΔfH298(Yb2Si2O7) = −1814.5 + 2(−905.489) − 158.87 = −3784.348 kJ/mol. Fusion is measured at 151 ± 8 kJ/mol; the phase-diagram temperature is 2123.15 K, so ΔSfus = 151000/2123.15 = 71.1207 J/(mol K). Solid Cp uses 3 n R and liquid Cp is 146 * 11/5 = 321.2 J/(mol K). Units: the Hess target is kJ/mol, Cp is J/(mol K), and ΔHfus = T ΔS/1000 is kJ/mol.
Yb2Si2O7(l).anchor_phase: Crystalline silicate at 298.15 K; the liquid Gibbs function is constructed through fusion and liquid Cp.
